retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast flash photograph of a group of friends seated on a plaid sofa against a patterned retro wallpaper, featuring a warm, vintage-filtered aesthetic.
excludeWhen: outdoor natural light settings are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of four women sitting closely on a brown plaid couch in a dimly lit room, illuminated by a harsh direct flash that creates high contrast and saturated skin tones. The background features a wood-paneled lower wall and a green geometric patterned wallpaper. The overall image has a square aspect ratio and a warm, slightly grainy vintage filter.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group centered horizontally on a plaid sofa
High-contrast flash lighting against a dark, patterned background
Warm color temperature with saturated skin tones and deep shadows
Text overlay positioned at the top, spanning the width of the frame
coreInvariants: Direct flash lighting effect with harsh shadows
Retro interior elements including plaid upholstery and geometric wallpaper
Square composition with subjects filling the lower two-thirds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects seated in a row, filling the mid-ground and foreground from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central group of friends, specifically the interaction of their seated poses.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold text at the top, move down to the faces of the subjects, and follow the line of the sofa across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, primarily located in the upper corners and the floor area.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and tans from the sofa and wood paneling.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark blues in the clothing and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted greens in the wallpaper and floral patterns on clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in skin tones due to flash; high value contrast between lit subjects and dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly bright modern synthetic colors

treatment.shadow: Soft black drop shadow for legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold sans-serif for maximum impact and legibility against a busy background.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, ubiquitous look of the original text.
Provides a similar geometric structure and weight.
Modern alternative with similar legibility and proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square photo of four women sitting on a plaid couch in a retro room with green geometric wallpaper, using harsh direct flash and a warm vintage filter.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold white sans-serif text centered at the top of the image with a subtle black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Text is legible against the patterned background
Flash lighting creates distinct shadows behind subjects
Color palette remains warm and vintage-toned

adjustableVariables: Number of people in the group
mustRedesign: Avoid using copyrighted logos or specific brand names in the text
Ensure the flash effect does not wash out facial features entirely

mustAchieve: Clear separation between subjects and background

postGenerationChecks: Check for harsh flash shadows on the wall
Verify the plaid pattern on the sofa is consistent
Ensure the text is centered and bold
recipe.reuseFormula: Group portrait + plaid sofa + retro wallpaper + direct flash + vintage filter + bold sans-serif header.
